adjudication.rationale: In `group/members.hbs` the loop was changed from `{{#each m in model}}` to `{{#each m in members}}`, but `group-members` route `setupController` only does `controller.set("model", model); model.findMembers();`. `findMembers()` now sets `members` on the *Group model* (`self.setProperties({ members: ... })`), not on the controller. Unless the `GroupMembersController` is an `Ember.ObjectController` (or otherwise proxies/aliases `members` to `model.members`), `members` will be undefined in the template and the list will render empty. The diff itself does not add such a proxy/alias.
